turns.question: In your own words, tell me everything you remember about what happened. Include every detail, even ones that seem small or unimportant.
turns.answer: I was waiting at the crossing by the bakery when a dark estate car came round the corner too fast. It clipped the back wheel of a cyclist and he fell against the kerb. The car slowed for a second, then drove off towards the bridge. I think the driver wore a cap. There was a sticker on the rear window, white, maybe round.

turns.question: You said dark estate car. Tell me everything you remember about it.
turns.answer: It was round and white, with something written in the middle that I could not read. It was on the left side of the window.
